data.one_liner: Serve GraphQL APIs over HTTP and WebSockets using the Angel3 framework.
data.what_it_does: Provides request handlers to serve GraphQL schemas, GraphiQL interfaces, file uploads, and WebSockets subscriptions within an Angel3 backend application. It supports schema resolvers integrated with Angel services.
use_when: You are building a backend application using the Angel3 framework and want to expose a GraphQL API.
You need to handle GraphQL queries, mutations, subscriptions, and file uploads over HTTP and WebSockets.
avoid_when: you are not using the Angel3 backend framework.
You are building a client-side Flutter application rather than a server.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with Angel3 services for quick CRUD operations.
Supports modern GraphQL WebSocket subprotocols (graphql-transport-ws) and file uploads.
Includes built-in GraphiQL support for API exploration.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Angel3 framework ecosystem.
Requires build_runner and code generation for model types.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding angel3_graphql and its dependencies to pubspec.yaml, and running build_runner to generate types from models.
